answers.notes: This kit generates scripts that New-E2ETestSet.ps1 does NOT deploy itself - you run Deploy-IntuneScripts.ps1 against the generated folders yourself, against a DEV tenant. confirmDevTenant is a safety gate: New-E2ETestSet.ps1 refuses to generate anything until you set it to true, as confirmation that you understand this and that -Path in your own Deploy-IntuneScripts.ps1 run will point at a dev tenant's script folder, not production. runPrefix is stamped on every generated script's Intune display name AND is what Remove-E2ETestSet.ps1 matches on to clean up afterwards - keep it deliberately loud (the ZZZ- sorts it to the bottom of an alphabetical script list too) so leftover test scripts are obvious at a glance if cleanup is ever skipped or fails. Bump it (e.g. ZZZ-E2E-TEST-DELETE-ME-2) to start a fresh, non-colliding batch instead of updating the previous one - just remember Remove-E2ETestSet.ps1 only matches the CURRENT runPrefix, so clean up the old batch under its own prefix before changing this.

include.notes: Used by the '#group: by name' and '#group: by guid' tests. Fill in displayName to generate the by-name variant, guid to generate the by-guid variant; fill in both to get both. Leave both blank and both variants are skipped (noted in CHECKLIST.md).

includeSecondary.notes: A second group, assigned alongside 'include' by the multi-#group: test. That test uses display names, so only displayName is read here.

exclude.notes: Used by the #excludegroup: tests, alone (everyone except this group) and combined with 'include'.
